_readme: Source-of-truth business rules for the ASF Display Program Tracker. attributes: DisplayingDealers code -> friendly current-display name. updateMap: same code -> list of display names the dealer needs to receive (empty = already current). skuMap: InventoryID -> which display that SKU counts toward. Edit this file and re-run/redeploy to change the rules; both the static dashboard and the live Worker read from it. requiredSkus (optional): for a display listed here, ONLY the listed SKUs count as fulfilling/scheduling that update — other SKUs mapped to the same display in skuMap still show in line detail but do not mark it complete. Omit a display from requiredSkus to keep the default behavior (any mapped SKU counts). collectionAliases (optional): maps a display name to the Collection field value(s) actually used on GC-SalesByCollectionTrailing12, for cases where the sales-tagging Collection name doesn't exactly match the display name elsewhere (e.g. both Sequoia generations are tagged simply "Sequoia" in that GI). Omit a display to match its own name directly. displaySystemLabels: normalizes AR-Customers.DisplaySystem raw tokens (mix of short codes like 1TOWER and descriptive text like "Single Tower" for the same underlying fixture) to one canonical label each, so the dashboard filter/dedup treats them as identical.
